flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8765/ then Open the page.
Click "Add item ($10)" two times so the cart holds two items and the total reads $20.
Then click "Apply SAVE10 coupon".
The reporter says the total should drop to $10 after the coupon.
Verify that the total shows $10.
